mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.conversation_id) AS conversations, COUNT(*) AS messages, COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(m.completion_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.cost_ms), 0) AS costMs FROM t_agent_message m JOIN t_agent_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id

SELECT m.model AS model, COUNT(*) AS messages, COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.cost_ms), 0) AS costMs FROM t_agent_message m JOIN t_agent_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
GROUP BY m.model ORDER BY promptTokens + completionTokens DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS messages, COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens FROM t_agent_message m JOIN t_agent_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
AND m.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT c.create_by AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, u.username AS username, COUNT(*) AS messages, COALESCE(SUM(m.prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(m.cost_ms), 0) AS costMs FROM t_agent_message m JOIN t_agent_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = c.create_by
m.role = 'assistant'
AND c.create_by = #{ownerId}
GROUP BY c.create_by, u.nickname, u.username ORDER BY promptTokens + completionTokens DESC
